name: unshell
description: A development environment for people and agents

scripts.dev: pnpm build:packages && concurrently --kill-others -n api,mac "pnpm dev:api" "pnpm dev:mac"
scripts.dev:desktop: echo "[deprecated] dev:desktop: the Electron desktop is deprecated pending removal; use pnpm dev:mac" >&2 && pnpm --filter unshell-desktop dev
scripts.verify: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm release:check
scripts.package:desktop: echo "[deprecated] package:desktop: the Electron desktop is deprecated pending removal; use just mac-app release" >&2 && pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter unshell-desktop package
scripts.test:desktop: echo "[deprecated] test:desktop: the Electron desktop is deprecated pending removal; use just mac-release-check" >&2 && pnpm release:check && node --import tsx scripts/smoke-desktop.mjs
